subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding polynomial functions of degree higher than two, including end behavior
source_inspiration: adapted from Japan MEXT Courses of Study sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student builds physical value tables for cubic and quartic functions and observes their shape and end behavior
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a polynomial's degree and leading coefficient to its correct end-behavior graph
exercise.abstract: Student predicts the end behavior of a given polynomial function from its degree and leading coefficient

misconception_flags: assumes all polynomials behave the same at the ends regardless of degree or leading coefficient sign

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
